classification.difficultyReason: Find the exact roots with the quadratic formula, then calculate their mean and product using cancellation and conjugate multiplication; these are routine linked procedures.

content.prompt: What is the average of the solutions and what is the product of the solutions of $2x^2+14x+17=0$?

answer.short:
Average: $-\dfrac72$. Product: $\dfrac{17}{2}$.

Use the exact quadratic solutions to calculate their average and product.
answer.worked:
Using the quadratic formula:
$$\begin{align*}x&=\frac{-14\pm\sqrt{14^2-4(2)(17)}}{2(2)}\\x&=\frac{-14\pm\sqrt{60}}4\\x&=\frac{-7\pm\sqrt{15}}2.\end{align*}$$
Let $\alpha=\dfrac{-7+\sqrt{15}}2$ and $\beta=\dfrac{-7-\sqrt{15}}2$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Average}&=\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\\\text{Average}&=\frac{(-7+\sqrt{15})+(-7-\sqrt{15})}{4}\\\text{Average}&=-\frac72.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\alpha\beta&=\frac{(-7+\sqrt{15})(-7-\sqrt{15})}{4}\\\alpha\beta&=\frac{49-15}{4}\\\alpha\beta&=\frac{17}{2}.\end{align*}$$
